title: Virago
summary: VIRA'GO, noun [Latin from vir, a man.] 1. A woman of the extraordinary stature, strength and courage; a female who has the robust body and masculine mind of a man; a female warrior. To arms! to arms!

inlines.v: VIRA'GO, noun [Latin from vir, a man.] 1. A woman of the extraordinary stature, strength and courage; a female who has the robust body and masculine mind of a man; a female warrior. To arms! to arms! the fierce virago cries. 2. In common language, a bold, impudent, turbulent woman; a termagant.
